title: Budget and Revenue
text:
This page examines the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide box office revenue. Figure Figure 1 shows how the two variables are related.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film Production Budget vs. Worldwide Revenue

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
This page explores the relationship between movie runtime and IMDb ratings. As shown in Figure 1, the scatter plot compares the runtime of each film with its IMDb rating.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating

title: The Bond Films
text:
This page examines the worldwide box office revenue of James Bond films over time.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

title: The Bond Films
text:
Bond Films Over Time
The first Bond film in this dataset was released in 1995, and the last was released in 2021.
The chart below shows how worldwide box office revenue changed across the Bond films in this dataset.

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Films: Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Worldwide Box Office Revenue of James Bond Films
